Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

abilities.name: Aquacrest Saber
abilities.caveat: The Hold-E variant (Aquacrest Saber Hold) channels and releases up to 22 Dewdrop hits each consuming 4% of Traveler's current HP (gated above 50% HP). Each Dewdrop's per-hit FlatDmg scales with Traveler's MaxHP via dewdropBonus[lvl]. The HP-cost-per-tick + per-hit FlatDmg-on-MaxHP-scaling don't fit the schema's single-scaling damage Effect. The Hold-E variant is authored as a frame variant; per-tick damage and HP costs are not modeled.
_curatorNotes: Tap E (Aquacrest Saber Press): Torrent Surge at hitmark=25f, 340.7% ATK Hydro at lvl=10 (skillPress). Spiritbreath Thorn (Pneuma Arkhe) at +45f, 59.04% ATK Hydro, 9s ICD per spiritbreathThornICDKey.
Hold variant: 22-tick Dewdrop channel (chained 15f intervals after firstDewdrop=54f), then Torrent Surge + Spiritbreath. Authored with frames only; tick damage 59.04% ATK Hydro per Dewdrop omitted.
Frames Tap-E: skillPressFrames[0]=InitAbilSlice(45), ActionAttack=44 ActionBurst=44 ActionDash=40 ActionJump=41 ActionWalk=44 ActionSwap=43.
A4 (Suffusion Bonus): Hold-E HP consumed accumulates +45% as Torrent Surge FlatDmg, max 5000 bonus DMG. Not authored — composite scaling on HP-drained-amount.
C4 (Tide Tributary): on E cast, +20% Hydro DMG to active char for 4s. Could be authored as buff effect; skipped for terseness.
abilities.description:
Plays a wave of water with the discarded sword, dealing AoE Hydro DMG.

Tap
Delivers a single instance of Hydro DMG.

Hold
The Traveler will charge up Suffusion energy, releasing up to 22 Dewdrops one after another. After releasing, the skill ends with a Torrent Surge.

abilities.name: Rising Waters
abilities.caveat: C2 (Liquid Drift) extends the bubble duration to 7s and slows the bubble movement to 0.7s/tile (from 1.5s/tile) — yielding 14 ticks instead of 8. The planner renders the base 4s/8-tick case.
_curatorNotes: Burst spawns Rising Waters bubble at burstFirstHitmark[0]=34f from cast. Bubble drifts forward (1.5 tiles/tick, 0.5s/tick = 8 ticks over 4s base; 14 ticks over 7s with C2). Per-tick burstDot[lvl=10]=183.36% ATK Hydro.
Authored as summons[] with summonTick effect at 0.5s interval, firstTickDelay 0.
Burst frames: burstFrames[0]=InitAbilSlice(78), ActionAttack=76 ActionJump=77 ActionSwap=76. Per Q-spec swap/N/E/D/J — E/D default to animLen=78.
Cooldown: SetCD(burst, 20*60). EnergyMax=80. ConsumeEnergy(consumeEnergyFrame[0]=4) drains 4 energy from teammates.
Bubble follows a fixed forward path from cast position — modeled as stationary (movement isn't visualized in our planner).
abilities.description: The Traveler unleashes a wave of water that summons a Hydro bubble at their location, which deals continuous Hydro DMG to opponents within its AoE.

passives.name: Suffusion
_curatorNotes: A1 (Outflow): Hold-E Dewdrop hits also generate Spiritbreath Thorn Pneuma damage as part of the absorption mechanic. Pneuma alignment isn't a schema field; flagged.
passives.description:
Outflow.
While using Aquacrest Saber's Hold mode, Suffusion is triggered: Aether/Lumine consumes their own HP and releases additional Dewdrops, dealing further Hydro DMG.

passives.name: Rising Waters
_curatorNotes: A4 (Suffusion Bonus): HP drained via Suffusion accumulates +45% as Torrent Surge FlatDmg bonus, max 5000 DMG. Not authored — drain-aggregate scaling on a separate skill action.
passives.description: If HP has been consumed via Suffusion while using the Hold Mode Aquacrest Saber, the Torrent Surge at the skill's end will deal Bonus DMG equal to 45% of the total HP the Traveler has consumed in this skill use via Suffusion. The maximum DMG Bonus that can be gained this way is 5,000.

constellations.name: Liquid Drift
_curatorNotes: C2: Rising Waters bubble duration +3s (4s → 7s); movement speed -30%. Authored conceptually in caveat; summon duration override via constellation not yet supported.
constellations.description: The Movement SPD of Rising Waters' bubble will be decreased by 30%, and its duration increased by 3s.
